summary:
**Mission Beyond Earth – Interactive 3D Space Mission Design and Simulation Platform**

Mission Beyond Earth is a browser-based interactive 3D platform developed to make space exploration easier and more engaging for students, educators, and space enthusiasts. It allows users to design, customize, and simulate space missions, including lunar exploration, Mars missions, and near-Earth asteroid tracking. Users can customize spacecraft using different components, select launch vehicles, and monitor important resources such as spacecraft mass, power, fuel, and mission budget in real time. The platform also includes seven automated pre-launch validation checks to ensure mission requirements are satisfied. It uses scientific references from NASA and JPL to provide realistic, educational experiences. By combining 3D visualization, spacecraft customization, and physics-based simulations, the project bridges the gap between theoretical learning and practical understanding. Our goal is to make space mission design accessible to everyone and inspire the next generation of space explorers.
details: Mission Beyond Earth is an interactive 3D space mission design and simulation platform developed to make space exploration accessible and engaging for students, educators, and space enthusiasts. It allows users to design, customize, and simulate space missions, including Moon exploration, Mars exploration, and near-Earth asteroid tracking. Users can customize spacecraft using nine modular components, select different launch vehicles, and monitor important resources such as spacecraft mass, power, propellant reserves, and mission budget in real time. The platform also includes seven automated pre-launch validation checks to ensure that mission requirements are satisfied. It was developed using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Vite, Three.js, React Three Fiber, and Drei, along with a custom orbital mechanics engine. NASA and JPL scientific references are used to provide scientifically grounded educational information. AI tools supported the development process through research, code generation, debugging, UI/UX design, and documentation. The creativity of this project lies in combining interactive 3D visualization, spacecraft customization, resource monitoring, and physics-based simulation in a single browser-based platform. The project bridges the gap between theoretical knowledge and practical learning, improves STEM education, and encourages students to develop an interest in aerospace technology and space exploration. Our team considered scientific accuracy, educational value, accessibility, user experience, spacecraft limitations, and mission requirements while developing this platform.
